paragraphs: He spoke in the name of Resh Lakish. He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 117a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.117a.5), and [Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Metzia.117a.5.2) there that he was a sage, a student of Resh Lakish.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara spells the name ו[יו]סטיני. Rashi calls him a sage and a student of Resh Lakish.

[Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1063&lang=en) records the suggestion that the letters should instead be read as a word for clay, then argues for the personal name from a Yerushalmi parallel.
